public.title: Circular Buffer
public.description: Maintain a bounded FIFO buffer of integers. capacity is 1 through 20. Operations ["push",value] evict the oldest if full and return null; ["shift"] returns/removes oldest or null; ["values"] returns the current oldest-to-newest array. Return one result per operation. Supported inputs contain at most 100 array entries per sequence and at most 20 operations or requests per sequence, at most 60 total object properties and array elements in any single JSON value, nesting depth at most 8, strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless specified otherwise, and integers from -100 through 100 unless a tighter or explicit alternate bound is stated. The entire argument JSON encoding is at most 1000 bytes. Nested sequences collectively have at most 100 entries; output snapshots therefore remain bounded. Inputs always satisfy the described shape and bounds.
hints: Evict the oldest item when pushing into a full buffer.
Check the public examples against the documented empty-input and boundary rules.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and reference code, 2026. Covers a common JavaScript practice topic; no third-party prose or code copied.

explanation: Use FIFO insertion/removal and copy values for snapshots. With array shifting and snapshots, O(n squared) time and output space in the worst case over n operations. This JSON adapter verifies observable results; it does not establish built-in-method restrictions, garbage collection, browser behavior or real timer/microtask scheduling.
